video-production-assets/assets/archive-audit-template.md — coverage area:
- Processing status is reported per mode, not one overall complete count.
- Coverage ledger: one row per stable archive_id × mode; identity derives from persistent file path/identifier, never list order/ordinal; each row includes exact filename and evidence locator; separate discovered/extracted count from actually reviewed count; explicit 0/not run/partial(first N).
- Columns: stable archive_id; exact filename; coverage mode; attempted/completed or extracted → actually reviewed; exact source range/sampling; timestamp-list completeness; evidence locator; status/limits.
- Distinct row modes: full-source decode (decoded status; decode is not visual review); scene locator/timestamps (candidates found, entries retained/candidates, exact PTS/ranges and threshold, completeness all/first N/partial/none; locator candidates are not cuts); still/strip extraction (counts, exact intervals, sampling rate/frames, timestamp source/completeness, image/manifest paths); manual visual review (extracted items vs items actually inspected, exact intervals, review record/image locator; not continuous playback); continuous playback (sources/segments watched, exact played ranges; full only if continuously watched); audio listening (sources/segments heard, exact ranges; metadata alone is not listening). Include every relevant mode, even 0/not reviewed.

Full decode or contact-sheet review alone is not full temporal analysis.

The form is source-neutral; report only supplied facts and preserve the archive-audit-template structure.
